title: I’m Glad There Is You (F major)

details.title: I’m Glad There Is You
details.lead: Jimmy Dorsey and Paul Madeira, 1941. The chorus as it is written, in F major: concert D4 to F5. Each A section starts on long notes that step down by half steps, E, E♭, D, before it lifts; the last one climbs to the high F and comes home. Slow, about 66 a minute.
